about: The NavisLabs launch film, as data. The Remotion project reads scene timing (scenes), every on-screen beat (timing.beats, timing.typing) and the film's own copy (onscreen_copy) from this file; voice, music and SFX slots live in navislabs_final_audio_map.json. Edit here, re-render.

brand.allowed_navis_in_ui: Real product UI text that says 'Navis' (e.g. 'Today · Navis', 'Why Navis surfaced this', 'NAVIS WORK CONTINUITY', the sidebar brand) stays, because it is the product's own text.

type.app_ui: Inter (system UI stand-in: Inter is not bundled)

narrative.thesis: Companies already have the intelligence they need, but it is scattered; NavisLabs turns it into one shared understanding that people use through Navis Application and AI agents use through Navis Developer.
arc: Why current software is not enough
Why it matters as AI agents scale
narrative.one_company_story: NavisLabs runs on its own products. Abhishek (founder) sees in Navis Application that the Acme Corp renewal is at risk and replies after editing the draft; in parallel his Claude Code agent updates NavisLabs' renewal logic and gets the same Acme facts from Navis Developer. Acme Corp, Jordan Lee and all facts are DEMO DATA.

real_abhishek.name: Abhishek Meena
real_abhishek.repository_folder: NavisLabs (as written in the brief; the Navis Developer source repository on this Mac is a different folder)

scenes.act: Why it matters as agents scale

shots.shown: Black; a point of cobalt becomes a thin line.
shots.why: Opens on the thesis without a product claim.

shots.shown: Five signal cards attach to the line, each with the system it came from: decision, customer, commitment, meeting, context.
shots.why: Makes 'operating memory' concrete with one company story (Acme renewal) that returns in both products.

shots.shown: The line breaks; each card flies into its system's tile; six tiles, unconnected.
shots.why: The problem: the truth exists but is split across systems.

shots.shown: Split: PEOPLE copy pieces into a note by hand; AGENTS open a session with nothing.
shots.why: Why current software is not enough, for both audiences.

shots.shown: Claude Code in a terminal; the task is typed.
shots.why: Every task starts by needing company context.

shots.shown: 'What does this company already know?' — large type on black; then a breath of silence.
shots.why: The question the company answers.

shots.shown: NavisLabs lockup (website treatment) and the line.
shots.why: Company name lands on a beat of silence.

shots.shown: The website's light canvas; six real vendor marks connect; signals (EMAIL, MEETING, COMMITMENT, PROJECT, CUSTOMER, DECISION) flow into NavisLabs; ONE SHARED UNDERSTANDING; six entities.
shots.why: Where the understanding comes from — the systems the company already uses.
shots.source: navis-labs-website logos.tsx (supported) and pipeline.tsx ('One live model of people, projects, decisions and commitments')

shots.shown: Product caption; Navis Application's Today page rises: 'Today · Navis', 'Good morning, Abhishek.', the Acme priority.
shots.why: Shows the product, not a description of it.
shots.source: Navis-AI PageMasthead, DailyBriefHero, NarrativeCard; website Morning Intelligence content

shots.shown: Cut to a macro of 'What changed · Verified shifts only' with one 'Just learned' card.
shots.why: Voice says 'what changed'; screen shows What changed.

shots.shown: Cut to 'Waiting on you': '1 thing is waiting on you · 1 person is waiting on your reply'.
shots.why: Voice says 'what's waiting'.

shots.shown: Click 'Why this matters' → 'Why Navis surfaced this'; evidence rows and the film's TRACE notes (source, timeline, freshness).
shots.why: Every conclusion has evidence behind it.

shots.shown: 'What you can do' → 'Review & reply' → DecisionDrawer → 'Review draft' → 'Preparing the draft…'.
shots.why: What should happen next — prepared, not executed.

shots.shown: The draft; Abhishek selects one sentence and writes his own; 'Saved' → 'Save changes'; cursor to 'Approve & send'. Caption: NAVIS PREPARES · A PERSON DECIDES.
shots.why: The person decides.

shots.shown: 'Approved — sending' → 'Sending…' → Gmail accepted → 'Reply sent · Gmail accepted the message.'
shots.why: Sent only after a real provider receipt.

shots.shown: Hard cut: VS Code (NavisLabs repository, renewals.ts) with Claude Code in the integrated terminal, prompt abhishekmeena@Abhisheks-MacBook-Pro-8; the task is typed; the agent says what it is missing.
shots.why: Abhishek's real environment; the agent needs company context.
shots.source: Real macOS user/host; Claude Code LIVE VERIFIED (CLIENTS.md)

shots.shown: navis_get_relevant_context → ACME CORP: relevant decision, customer, open commitment, owner, last customer response — each with SOURCE and FRESHNESS.
shots.why: The right company context, with provenance.

shots.shown: macOS Terminal: Day 1 'Checkpoint recorded for NavisLabs (main).' → DAY 2 · new session → NAVIS WORK CONTINUITY restores CURRENT TASK / DECISIONS / OPEN.
shots.why: The right work state — restored by Navis Developer, not remembered by the model.
shots.source: Devtool packages/cli workstate.ts, workstate/restore.ts, checkpoint.ts, commands/hook.ts

shots.shown: Two keys: agent key AUTHORIZED; read-only key DENIED → the exact refusal.
shots.why: The right permissions.

shots.shown: Back in VS Code: the agent applies the change (diff) and reports what it used.
shots.why: The agent works inside the organization's context.

shots.shown: Navis Developer Console → Runs: the task, two runs, 'Completed', 'CLI session'.
shots.why: Agent work is on record.

shots.shown: Two quiet type cards on black.
shots.why: Why existing categories are not enough.

shots.shown: HERO: Navis Application (people) left, Navis Developer (developers + AI agents) right, NavisLabs centre; the same Acme signal travels from one to the other through NavisLabs; ONE SHARED UNDERSTANDING.
shots.why: The core brand image: two products, one understanding.
shots.source: Same demo facts in both products

shots.shown: 'Models will change.' 'Agents will change.' The company's own entities hold, then gather into the mark.
shots.why: What stays as agents scale: the company's own understanding.

shots.shown: End card: NavisLabs lockup; NAVIS APPLICATION for people; NAVIS DEVELOPER for developers + AI agents; ONE SHARED UNDERSTANDING; navislabs.in.
shots.why: Remember the company and its two products.

rules: Product is the hero; motion clarifies.
Macro crops and hard cuts within real UI; no particles, no neon, no gradients beyond the website's.
Cobalt only on the line and the logo.

camera.model: world-space camera: keyframes {f,x,y,scale,easing}; a keyframe note containing 'cut' is a hard cut
camera.style: slow, controlled; macro crops for proof; hard cuts on 'what changed', 'what's waiting', 'Navis Developer', 'work state', 'permissions'

cursor.style: macOS arrow; every click causes the next beat

sections: M1 almost silent; low atmospheric tension
M2 a subtle pulse enters under the problem
M3 NavisLabs: a low swell, then the systems connect
M5 developer rhythm, restrained electronic texture — Navis Developer
M6 build through the hero shot and the closing thought

transitions.kind: line breaks; signals return to their systems
line wipe from ink to the website canvas
hard cut — back to VS Code
words gather into the mark; end card
